shots.vo: Quick question. Do you think you have to be technical to learn AI?
You don't. I'm Seth Shoultes, and I teach in plain words — and we start from your real work.
I help you learn AI... by doing real work.
Business owners who want AI working in their business, not just a demo. People changing careers, who want to learn what matters and skip what doesn't. And anyone curious.
One-on-one coaching. Tell me where you are and where you want to be, and we work out a plan together.
A workshop for your team. A hands-on session for you and your people.
The monthly meetup. AI and WordPress, in Southern Utah. Everyone is welcome.
And my writing. I write about building with AI.
Why learn from me? I've spoken at small events and run workshops inside companies, on and off — for over twenty years.
